Between zigzagging tariffs, rapid pivots in geopolitics, and questions about the future of the Federal Reserve’s independence, there has been no shortage of unprecedented and alarming policies in President Donald Trump’s second term.  The upshot is that even if U.S. markets as a whole keep climbing—thanks to catalysts like artificial intelligence and economic growth—indvidiual companies have to navigate a seemingly constantly changing landscape.
